feeds.title: CauseHealth
feeds.description: Causation is central to our understanding of human health and illness. Medical explanation, prediction and intervention are all premised on the reality of causation and philosophy is best placed to account for its nature. CauseHealth brings together philosophers, medical researchers and practitioners to address a major challenge: how to understand causation in health sciences.

feeds.title: The Academy For Healthcare Science
feeds.description: The Academy is the single overarching body for the entire Healthcare Science workforce in the UK and works alongside the specialist professional bodies to speak with one clear voice for Healthcare Science.

feeds.title: The Health Sciences Academy Blog
feeds.description: The Health Sciences Academy is an educational online training provider, which focuses on science-based courses, from Sports and Exercise Nutrition, to Clinical Weight Loss, to Advanced Supplements.

feeds.title: Sport and health science courses at Brighton Blog
feeds.description: The University of Brighton is a thriving, coastal university delivering courses that fulfil ambitions; research that transforms lives and knowledge that nurtures communities worldwide.

feeds.title: Annals of Medical and Health Sciences Research
feeds.description: The Annals of Medical and Health Sciences Research is a peer-reviewed Open Access Journal dedicated to publishing of the most comprehensive and reliable research in medical and health sciences.

feeds.title: Wiley | Nursing & Health Sciences
feeds.description: Nursing & Health Sciences (NHS) is a premier international journal focusing on the exchange of knowledge in nursing and health sciences, particularly between the East and West.

feeds.title: The Health Science Journal
feeds.description: The Health Science Journal began as a shared vision for a free consumer health publication that points readers to modern and traditional health resources.

feeds.title: ACHS Health and Wellness Blog
feeds.description: The American College of Healthcare Sciences blog covers all aspects of holistic health and wellness - Aromatherapy, Herbal Medicine, Holistic Nutrition, Coaching, Wellness, and also follows up with advice on how to live a more holistic life. ACHS is accredited by DEAC and recognized throughout the holistic health community.

feeds.title: ICNR Blog
feeds.description: Covers news & updates from International Center for Nutritional Research (ICNR). Dr. Smith is certified by the World Organization for Natural Medicine to practice natural medicine globally and is a certified dental practitioner. His broad base of post-graduate training in dentistry and natural medicine enabled him to integrate many health care specialties.

feeds.title: Science Arena
feeds.description: A noble forum for academics, professionals, educators, practitioners and students to contribute original, innovative, previously unpublished, articles on environment, biotechnology, health and food science, molecular science and promote scientific discussion.

feeds.title: Archives of Medicine and Health Sciences
feeds.description: AMHS is dedicated to the publication of scholarly and outstanding peer-reviewed articles to foster education, research and professionalism in the fields of Internal Medicine, Clinical and Allied Health Sciences including Nursing, Physiotherapy, Dental and Medical Education.

feeds.title: Saudi Journal for Health Sciences
feeds.description: Saudi Journal for Health Sciences is a quarterly peer-reviewed international journal published by Taif University. The journal covers basic and applied medical and health sciences including ethical and social issues.
